notes: This file is the canonical dashboard matrix; Cloudflare does not import it automatically.
Create or connect the Worker named ddtank-r2-deployer to this repository.
Keep preview builds disabled so non-main branches cannot publish production objects.

The production command validates the R2 object gateway, deploys the current Worker, materializes immutable browser-ready runtime exports, uploads the full-resource profile, probes the public gateway, and then prunes every bucket object outside the full-resource allowlist.
The prune step preserves all configured profile manifests and refuses to run from a partial profile or an unexpectedly small managed file set.
External runtime source updates require an immutable pin change in r2-deployment.json.
The Worker exposes canonical /objects/<key> GET/HEAD/Range routes; legacy immutable aliases exist only for rollback compatibility.
Internal roots such as _review are never public Worker routes and are removed from the R2 bucket by the post-deploy prune step.
Set R2_PUBLIC_BASE_URL only after a custom domain or temporary r2.dev URL is enabled.
